user.title: Add a Calendarific instance
user.description: Each instance tracks holidays for one country/state combination, grouped under a single device.

data.name: Friendly name (Leave blank to generate one from country/state)

data_description.name: A name for this instance. If left blank, one is generated from the country and state.
data_description.api_key: The API key from your Calendarific account.
data_description.country: The two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code, for example US or GB.
data_description.state: An optional ISO 3166-2 subdivision code for regional holidays. Leave blank for national holidays only.

defaults.title: Instance defaults
defaults.description: These settings apply to every holiday in this instance, unless you override them for a specific holiday later.

data.icon_today: Icon when a holiday is today
data.days_as_soon: Number of days to consider a holiday 'soon'
data.icon_soon: Icon when a holiday is soon

data_description.icon_normal: Icon shown while the holiday is further away than the 'soon' threshold, for example mdi:calendar-blank.
data_description.icon_today: Icon shown on the day of the holiday.
data_description.days_as_soon: A holiday this many days away or fewer counts as 'soon'.
data_description.icon_soon: Icon shown while the holiday is 'soon'.
data_description.date_format: How the date attribute is written, using Python strftime codes such as %Y-%m-%d (see strftime.org).
data_description.unit_of_measurement: Text shown after the number of days.

customize_values.title: Customize {holiday}
customize_values.description: Values shown are this holiday's current effective settings (its own override, or the instance default). Check 'Reset to default' to discard any override for this holiday and go back to using the instance defaults - other fields are ignored if checked. A friendly name only changes the display name - it won't rename this holiday's already-assigned entity ID; use the entity's own settings dialog for that.

data.name: Friendly name (leave blank to use the holiday name)
data.icon_today: Icon when this holiday is today
data.days_as_soon: Number of days to consider this holiday 'soon'

data_description.name: A display name for this holiday's sensor. Leave blank to use the holiday's own name. This does not change the entity ID.

data_description.icon_today: Icon shown on the day of the holiday.
